featured.title: Sundar Pichai Is Selling $85 Billion of Alphabet to Win the AI Race. Investors Are Divided.
featured.excerpt: The largest equity offering in tech history includes a $10 billion anchor from Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway. Alphabet plans to spend up to $190 billion this year alone — and it ordered three million TPUs from Intel.
featured.image_caption: Sundar Pichai, CEO of Alphabet and Google
featured.nri_angle: Sundar Pichai's most consequential financial gamble reshapes the company tens of thousands of Indian engineers call home — and it may determine whether Google or OpenAI defines the next era of computing.
featured.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: The US-Iran Deal Is Done. Oil Has Dropped 4 Per Cent. Here Is What It Means for India.
news.excerpt: The Strait of Hormuz will reopen immediately. The naval blockade is over. A signing ceremony is set for Friday in Switzerland. And India's oil import bill just got significantly lighter.
news.image_caption: Map of the Strait of Hormuz, the narrow waterway between Iran and Oman that carries a fifth of the world's oil
news.nri_angle: Cheaper crude oil means a stronger rupee, lower petrol prices in India, and relief for NRIs watching the currency slide all year.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Modi Meets Trump Wednesday at G7. Trade, Visas, and Three Dead Sailors Are All on the Table.
news.excerpt: The bilateral comes as Washington threatens a 12.5 per cent tariff, H-1B approvals have dropped 40 per cent, and India has twice summoned the U.S. envoy over the killing of Indian sailors in the Gulf.
news.image_caption: Prime Minister Narendra Modi at the G7 summit in Évian-les-Bains, France
news.nri_angle: The meeting will determine whether the 12.5% tariff threat is walked back, whether H-1B processing gets relief, and whether Trump acknowledges the sailor deaths — all issues that directly affect NRIs.

news.title: Meta Will Build a 168-Megawatt AI Data Centre Inside Ambani's Jamnagar Complex. Here Is Why It Matters.

news.nri_angle: India's AI infrastructure is moving from government promises to concrete projects — creating high-skilled jobs, boosting Jio Platforms' IPO profile, and potentially reducing dependence on foreign AI providers.

news.image_caption: U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer, who will visit India after the G7 Summit for trade negotiations
news.nri_angle: A U.S.-India trade deal directly affects NRIs through tariff structures on remitted goods, pharmaceutical pricing, IT services market access, and the broader economic relationship that shapes visa and immigration policy.

news.title: Modi and Macron Have Drawn Up a Five-Year Plan to Double Trade. Here Is Everything They Agreed at Villa Kerylos.

news.nri_angle: The bilateral outcomes directly affect NRIs through visa-free French airport transit, expanded education pathways, and a trade mechanism that could reshape India's commercial access to all 27 EU member states.

news.image_caption: Server infrastructure in a data centre — India's AI ambitions now face questions about technological sovereignty
news.nri_angle: Indian-origin engineers on H-1B visas at U.S. AI companies are now classified alongside all foreign nationals under the new export controls — making this both a policy story and a personal one for the diaspora workforce.

news.title: India Is Now Under Fire From Both Sides in the Gulf. The U.S. Struck Its Sailors. Trump Says Iran Attacked Its Ships Too.
news.excerpt: Three Indian seafarers are dead from a U.S. Navy strike. Hours later, Trump accused Iran of launching drones at Indian vessels. Jaishankar called Rubio to protest. India's 300,000 merchant sailors are caught in the middle of a war they played no part in starting.

news.nri_angle: India is the world's second-largest supplier of merchant seafarers — over 300,000 globally. Many NRI families in coastal states have relatives working on vessels in the Gulf, and the escalating attacks have triggered panic across the maritime community.

news.title: A Judge Killed the $100,000 H-1B Fee. Four Days Later, He Froze His Own Ruling.

news.title: The Iran Deal Draft Is Out. Here Is What Is in It — and What India Stands to Gain.
news.excerpt: Iran has reportedly agreed to abandon its nuclear weapons programme. The US will release roughly $20 billion in frozen assets and waive oil sanctions. The Strait of Hormuz — which carried 40 per cent of India's crude imports — would reopen immediately.

news.nri_angle: A reopened Strait of Hormuz would ease India's energy costs, lower inflation, and stabilise the rupee — all of which directly affect NRI remittances, investments, and the cost of travel home.

news.title: India Has Opened Its Stock Market to Every Foreigner. NRIs Are No Longer the Only Ones Who Can Buy In.
news.excerpt: A sweeping FEMA amendment notified on June 12 lets any individual living outside India invest in listed Indian companies — ending a decades-old framework that restricted the route to NRIs and OCIs alone.

news.nri_angle: NRIs who previously had exclusive access to Indian portfolio investments through FEMA now share that route with all foreign individuals, potentially reshaping competition and liquidity in Indian equities.

news.image_caption: The Reserve Bank of India building in Kolkata

news.nri_angle: A US-India trade deal — the first in 75 years — could push bilateral trade toward $500 billion and directly affect millions of Indian Americans and Indian businesses operating across both economies.

nri-world.nri_angle: The King's charity, built around British Asian identity, has supported 18.8 million people in South Asia — and his visible patronage during anti-Asian unrest sends a signal to the 1.9 million Indians in the UK.

nri-world.nri_angle: NRIs and OCIs who long enjoyed exclusive retail access to Indian equities now share that privilege with every foreign individual — a levelling that could reshape how diaspora investors think about their edge in India's capital markets.

carousel.title: The US-Iran Deal Is Done. Oil Has Dropped 4 Per Cent. Here Is What It Means for India.
carousel.excerpt: The Strait of Hormuz will reopen immediately. The naval blockade is over. A signing ceremony is set for Friday in Switzerland. And India's oil import bill just got significantly lighter.
carousel.image_caption: Map of the Strait of Hormuz, the narrow waterway between Iran and Oman that carries a fifth of the world's oil
carousel.nri_angle: Cheaper crude oil means a stronger rupee, lower petrol prices in India, and relief for NRIs watching the currency slide all year.

carousel.title: He Was Born in Melbourne to a Tamil Father and an Anglo-Indian Mother. In Vancouver, Nishan Velupillay Became the First Indian-Origin Player at a World Cup in 20 Years.
carousel.excerpt: Four players with Indian roots are scattered across the FIFA World Cup 2026 — from Punjab to Kerala to Sri Lankan Tamil heritage. None wear the India jersey. All carry the diaspora story.
carousel.image_caption: Nishan Velupillay training with Melbourne Victory in January 2023
carousel.nri_angle: India didn't qualify for the World Cup, but four players of Indian origin are carrying the diaspora flag across three continents — a bittersweet milestone for NRI football fans watching from their living rooms in New Jersey, London, and Toronto.

carousel.title: Sarvam AI Gets a Seat at the G7 Table. It's the Only Indian Company There.
carousel.excerpt: The IIT Madras-incubated startup will join Sam Altman, Dario Amodei, and Demis Hassabis at a working lunch with world leaders in Evian-les-Bains this week — a first for an Indian AI company.
carousel.image_caption: AI industry leaders gather at a global technology summit
carousel.nri_angle: India's sovereign AI ambitions now have a voice at the world's most powerful governance table — a signal to NRI engineers and investors that Indian-built AI is being taken seriously at the highest levels.

carousel.title: India Doubled Its Gold Tariff. Smugglers Are Making ₹25 Lakh Per Kilo Bar. NRIs Are Caught in the Middle.
carousel.excerpt: The 15 per cent import duty was meant to defend the rupee. Instead it has fuelled a grey-market revival that could hit 100 tons this year — while JP Morgan forecasts $6,000 gold by December.
carousel.nri_angle: NRIs buying gold for weddings or investment now face an 18.45 per cent embedded tax in India — reshaping how and where the diaspora acquires gold.
